name: viral-startup-launch-video
description: This skill should be used when the user asks to plan, script, audit, rewrite, storyboard, or optimize a startup launch video, product demo video, founder launch clip, X/Twitter launch video, Product Hunt launch asset, or short video meant to make viewers try a product. Trigger on phrases like "launch video", "startup launch", "viral launch clip", "make this demo punchier", "audit this product video", "write a founder launch video", "turn this product into a video that gets clicks", or "make people want to try this".
